text:
Margot: Quick heads-up — refreshing the hello-widget quickstart to adopt SDK v5 auth flow and the new deploy command. Pushing a draft PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4923
Sam (docs): Nice. Can you call out any breaking changes for starters? want a short migration note in the sidebar.
Margot: Yep. Main changes: token acquisition moves to SDK client, env var name changed from REDWOOD_KEY to REDWOOD_API_KEY, and deploy CLI flag changed. I'll add a 'What's different' note.
Jia: If the env var name changed we need examples for Dockerfile + Docker Compose too — otherwise customer's quickstart breaks.
Margot: Good call. Adding a minimal Dockerfile snippet. Anyone want to sanity-check before I merge?
Kevin: I'll run it locally tonight. small nit: the JS snippet uses `await client.generate({})` but SDK v5 uses `client.text.generate()` now.
Margot: Ack — will update. Draft snippet I have atm:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const res = await client.text.generate({ input: 'Hello, world' })
console.log(res.output[0].content)
```
Thoughts?
Alex (eng): Looks right. Suggest adding streaming example separately and link to streaming guide. Also add a small note about token scopes.
Sam (docs): Also found a broken link in the quickstart sidebar — points to /guides/auth-old. I'll open a quick fix PR unless you want to include it in this one.
Margot: :thumbsup: include it here please, Sam. Fewer deploys. Also adding a migration header to highlight changed env vars and function signatures.
docs-bot: PR 4923 created by @margot and assigned to @sam (docs), @kevin for review.
Kevin: Saw the PR — left inline comment about example wording. Will post test run results by 21:00 PT.
Sam (docs): I'll do a docs pass tomorrow AM; can we add a one-line 'expected output' so tests can assert the example?
Jia: I updated docker-compose.yml to use REDWOOD_API_KEY and made the port mapping explicit. Pushing patch to the PR.
Margot: Thanks all. Plan: Kevin verifies, Sam lints/edits, Jia adds docker snippet, Alex links streaming guide. Merge target: EOD Friday. If any blocking issues call out here.
